schema.description:
The complete `/readyz` response.

Note that the ready value is `ready`, not `ok`. The two probes report
different vocabularies, which was found by writing this spec against
the running code rather than from memory. It is recorded accurately
rather than tidied, because a client already parsing `ready` would
break if the server were changed to match a prettier spec — the spec
describes what ships (ADR-013).
schema.title: ReadinessStatus

503.description:
Not ready. The body names no dependency and gives no detail, on
purpose: this endpoint is reachable from the public ingress, and
"which of our dependencies is down" is not something to tell an
anonymous caller. The detail is in the logs and metrics.
